messages:
Anika Patel: Heads up — ACME released 'InstantEmbed Lite' this morning. Saw it on Crunchy post. :eyes: Potentially shifts our embeddings positioning. Thoughts on whether we need a parity sprint?
Sam Chen: skimmed it. Short summary: lower-dim embeddings, cheaper quantized packaging, no private deploy option. Looks like a self-serve disruptor, not enterprise.
Liam O'Connor: from infra side their claims read as packaging + aggressive quant. Not impossible but nontrivial: KV cache / batching changes.
Maya Rodriguez: Sales already flagged inbound asks from 2 startups asking for a "cheap embeddings" SKU. They want a concrete answer this week.
Riley Brooks: My take: don't do a full parity chase. Proposal: 1) ship an MVE "Embeddings Lite" for hosted self-serve only, 2) couple with strict SLOs + telemetry, 3) roadmap bigger perf/quant work after alpha.
Anika Patel: I like that. Proposed launch criteria for the MVE: 1) ~30% unit cost reduction vs current smallest model; 2) >=95% macro parity on our quality benchmark across dev prompt set; 3) telemetry + rollback policy in place. Any gaps?
Sam Chen: add default automatic fallback routing to full-precision model when OOD detection flags quality drop, and A/B hooks so we can measure downstream client impact by billable events.
Liam O'Connor: eng estimate: MVE is ~3 sprints (infra changes, quant test harness, canary infra). Biggest risk: KV cache invalidation patterns. Need to know what we deprioritize to hit that.
Maya Rodriguez: if PMs can give a firm alpha date within 6 weeks, Sales will hold off on blanket credits. Without it they'll push aggressive concessions.
Anika Patel: decision: triage this into next planning cycle. Scope for MVE = hosted self-serve only; no Dedicated/Private support until we validate quality. Owner ask: who will drive the tech design and acceptance criteria?
Riley Brooks: I'll write the PRD + acceptance tests. Liam + Sam own infra + routing design. Maya owns GTM comms. Target: alpha in 6 weeks, canary in prod after metrics look stable.
Sam Chen: I'll put the canary routing + metric checkboxes on the roadmap board. @deploy-bot can you set a reminder for an alpha checkpoint in 4 weeks?
deploy-bot: Reminder set: #product — "Embeddings Lite alpha checkpoint" in 4 weeks (ts:171877? ).
Maya Rodriguez: \u2705 I'll email top 10 inbound prospects: "we're evaluating a cost-tier, ETA update soon" — reduces immediate pressure.
Anika Patel: Nice. Quick action items: update public benchmarks page with note, add FAQ about parity expectations, Riley to share PRD draft in #product by EOD Thursday. Thanks all.
